hypothesis.claim: On the immutable opening-1M Endpoint428 population, the existing Fiber-FOSSIL route-local 16-byte exact continuation D has at least 4,080 exact finite-coder payload bytes of residual value over the parent, beats physical HORIZON/FOSSIL G, preceding-route S, random-route R, negated N, and unrestricted global-timeline T controls, remains positive in every chronological third, and has positive exact contribution in at least two frozen virtual-distance buckets.
hypothesis.falsification: Retire semantic-distance exact retrieval before Fiber-LOOM or route fast weights if the sealed route ABI, raw inverse, parent replay, arithmetic inverse, or repeat identity fails; D saves fewer than 4,080 payload bytes; D fails to beat any G/S/R/N/T control overall or in any chronological third; or fewer than two virtual-distance buckets have positive exact finite-coder contribution.

changedMechanism: Instantiate the already-named Fiber-FOSSIL/Fiber-HORIZON route-local exact-continuation question on the bounded Endpoint428 opening-1M evidence, adding an unrestricted global-timeline T control without creating a new algorithm family.
invariants: The coded population is the exact 600,742-byte WRT stream reconstructed from the 1,000,000-byte canonical raw prefix.
The parent P1 has exactly 4,805,936 nonzero uint16 rows and its finite arithmetic replay is byte-identical to the 173,859-byte payload of the immutable 173,896-byte Endpoint428 archive.
The semantic population is generated twice from sealed scanner blob b44fffb2b95c540535d293e1d0021f544a5b7e4d8fbb740721752a69b0c7866e under the GSRT2 192-byte header and 88-byte record ABI.
A semantic truth enters every route history only at its tape-declared causal availability; PP/RR structural pairs and field delimiters never enter value history.
D uses the current decoded route, S snapshots the immediately preceding completed route at field entry, and R assigns each field occurrence to one frozen SplitMix64 route bucket without using truth.

G is the physical 16-byte exact-continuation arm with the Endpoint428 greater-than-100,000,000-byte age gate; T is the identical physical global timeline without that age gate; N complements D before calibration.

Each arm and bit position owns isolated uint64 KT correct/wrong counts; pretruth probabilities use floor(((2*correct+1)*65536)/(2*(correct+wrong+1))) clamped to [1,65535], and update only after truth.
No route tape, donor coordinate, distance, selector, parent trace, raw corpus, or offline map is a submission input or receives archive or objective credit.
No active or partial HORIZON trace is opened, hashed, sampled, or consumed by this experiment.
